title: Rich and Hearty Irish Stew
description: A classic Irish stew recipe made with tender beef and vegetables, perfect for a cold winter's night. This stew is gluten-free and can be made in under an hour.
instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped bacon and cook until browned.
Remove the bacon from the pot and set aside.
Add the beef to the pot and cook until browned.
Add the onion, carrots, and potatoes to the pot.
Cook for 5 minutes, or until the vegetables are slightly tender.
Add the beef broth, tomato paste, salt, and pepper to the pot.
Return the bacon to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30 minutes.
Stir in the kidney beans and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
